description: By Samantha Handler and John Bresnahan, Punchbowl news “Rep. Betty McCollum (Minn.) is set to again lead the Defense panel. Democrats are already on a collision course with the White House over spending for the Iran war. This will only escalate if they get the gavels next year.”

title: The House Democrats to watch on Appropriations next year — Betty McCollum for Congress
